verdict.rationale: Evidence shows only APIs (Connect API, Apps SDK, MCP) and export formats (PDF/PNG/PPTX/etc.) for integration, but no documented open native design file format — Canva's underlying .canva design representation itself remains proprietary and undocumented; users must go through the vendor's own APIs/exports to get data out, not a portable open format usable in other tools without Canva's platform.
